usage: Usually refers to a security guard or building/security staff in Hong Kong.
Common in places like estates, offices, shopping malls, schools, and car parks.
Can be used as a general job title; in speech, people often say 保安員 for a more formal tone.
When talking about safety or control of access, 保安 is a very natural everyday word.
